applicability.expression: encounter.kind == 'registration' AND patient.clinical_status == 'established' AND SchizophreniaEstablished == 'Yes' AND PersistentSignificantSymptoms == 'Yes' AND TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials == 'Yes'
applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind, patient.clinical_status, and gate node states only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: patient.clinical_status first_time yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a first-time skip is never a negative posterior). Assessed No on any clinical gate member yields not_applicable with reason. Missing, partial, skipped-not_assessed, or conflicting gate member or gate constituent yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required non-gate input (urgent concern, clozapine status) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (12-week duration, severity/function features, willingness, monitoring plan, medical review) leaves that node without hard evidence; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All mapped states are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing clinical status blocks with needs_clarification; first_time yields not_applicable (never a posterior).
patient_mappings.node_id: ClinicalStatusGate (applicability input, not a network node)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Gate passes only when clinical_status == established. first_time never satisfies the gate.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unanswered, partial, skipped not_assessed, bypassed, or conflicting diagnosis blocks with needs_clarification (gate member). A bypassed diagnosis is not a confirmation.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician confirmation recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff diagnosis is complete with criteria met AND clinician confirmation is recorded in the current encounter; No iff assessed and not confirmed. Never inferred from symptom counts alone.

allowed_source_paths: content/assessments/panss.json#panss-v1 (supporting scale only, never a gate by itself)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing, partial, or conflicting judgment blocks with needs_clarification (gate member).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for the judgment; supporting scale/history in documented windows with recorded instrument name/version
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the clinician documents current clinically significant residual symptoms with symptom domains and validated scale/version. A 20 percent improvement does not automatically make this No. No iff the clinician assesses the criterion as not met; a PANSS total or band alone is never Yes or No.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog references or explicit unknown labels; drug identity only, no regimen detail)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing or conflicting assessment blocks with needs_clarification (gate constituent via TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials).
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval with recorded agent, dates, response, and adherence evidence; current_encounter for the adequacy determination
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Clinician-recorded adequacy category only: AdequateSuboptimalResponse iff adequate exposure with suboptimal response; AdequateSatisfactoryResponse iff adequate exposure with satisfactory response; InadequateExposure iff insufficient exposure by the TRRIP reference (at least 6 weeks at therapeutic dosage with at least 80 percent adherence); TruncatedByIntolerance iff prematurely truncated by intolerance (takes precedence). No dose, unit, route, frequency, duration number, or level is stored or requested (FR-14).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog references or explicit unknown labels; drug identity only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing or conflicting assessment blocks with needs_clarification (gate constituent via TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials).
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval with recorded agent, dates, response, and adherence evidence; independent of Trial 1
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Same four adequacy categories as Trial 1, assessed independently. Status only; no regimen detail (FR-14).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog drug identities; different agents checked by identity only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing or conflicting determination blocks with needs_clarification (gate constituent via TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the two assessed trials used different antipsychotic agents; different classes are not required. No iff the same agent was used. Checked by drug identity only.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unknown or not_assessed leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff significant symptoms persisted for at least 12 weeks in total with duration evidence documented; No iff assessed shorter. Additional research feature only; never a standalone eligibility gate.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing (the conditioning context notes the gap, with owner review of this rationale)

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unknown or not_assessed leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter with validated symptom and functioning measures
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff both symptom severity and functional impairment are at least moderate on validated measures (SOFAS below 60 is the source functioning example). No iff assessed below. Research feature only; not a universal eligibility gate.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing urgent assessment blocks with needs_clarification (required non-gate input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Present iff the clinician records suspected severe neutropenia, myocarditis/NMS, severe or unresolved constipation, or acute psychiatric danger requiring urgent assessment. Absent iff the clinician assesses no urgent concern. Absent does not certify safety.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog clozapine ingredient reference or explicit unknown label; status only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing or conflicting exposure status blocks with needs_clarification (required non-gate input; owner to confirm whether to relax to optional, Q6).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for current treatment; historical_event_dates for prior exposure
patient_mappings.typed_transform: CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; PreviouslyTreated iff past exposure is recorded; NeverTreated iff assessed never treated. Status only: no dose, duration, unit, route, or frequency is used or requested (FR-14).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input). Included only when defined and collected.
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the patient is currently willing to discuss clozapine; No iff currently unwilling. Willingness is not consent to treatment, and No never removes the indication flag.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input). Included only when defined and collected.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; feasibility per current local guidance
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff a feasible clinician-reviewed monitoring and follow-up plan is available, including ANC and relevant cardiac, bowel, metabolic, and other adverse-effect surveillance per current local guidance. No means a documented planning or logistical gap, not an absolute contraindication.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

allowed_source_paths: runs.pinned_ddi_report (separate informational report; never substituted for this review)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff a current clinician benefit-harm, contraindication, and interaction review is documented and initiation discussion is considered appropriate. Yes means the review was performed, not that clozapine is safe or appropriate; the conclusion remains a clinician responsibility. DDI findings stay a separate report and never substitute for this review.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branches rendered as review prompts only; the maximum posterior is never a treatment recommendation or a resistance certification. TRS-review, adequacy, research-feature, and preparation posteriors are always shown alongside the pathway branch as parallel review concerns. The deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs is shown first and never waits for the LLM. A false gate yields not_applicable (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior); an unknown required gate yields needs_clarification and stops later questions.
title: Established-case clozapine review at registration (R7)
